Hi Everyone,

I hope you're all doing well. Firstly, I want to express my gratitude for this platform.

I'm currently working on my SEM model estimation project, as shown in Figure below. At present, I am linking the variable "gender" to the variable "V1".


My questions are:   1.   If I link "gender" to variables V1, A1, and B1, is the current R syntax below correct? Do I need to include: A1 ~ gender, B1~ gender?  2. What effects should be controlled?

Syntax:

ModelTest <- '

#Covariates

V1 ~ gender  

# Autoregressive paths

V2 ~ V1

A2 ~ A1

B2 ~ B1

# Cross-lagged paths

B2 ~V1

B2 ~ A1

A2 ~ A1   

# Exogenous Covariance

V1 ~~ A1

V1 ~~ B1

A1 ~~ B1

# Residual Covariances

V2 ~~ A2

V2 ~~ B2

A2 ~~ B2

'

Looking forward to your insights and feedback. Thanks.

 

Francien
